issues.title: Coupon code not applying at checkout
issues.problem_statement: The customer's coupon code was not applying at checkout and showed an "Invalid coupon" message when used on the Advanced Course.

issues.title: Wrong company name on invoice
issues.problem_statement: The customer's invoice shows the wrong company name, in the GST part.

issues.title: Coupon expiry date extension
issues.problem_statement: The customer wants to extend the coupon's expiry date.

items.description: Support explained that the coupon was assigned only to the Starter Course and not the Advanced Course, so the product had to be assigned to it.
evidence: ye coupon sirf Starter Course ke liye assign hai, Advanced Course ke liye nahi.

items.description: Customer edited the coupon, selected the Advanced Course in its Products section and saved it, following support's guidance, then tested and confirmed the discount now shows at checkout.
evidence: Ho gaya. Ab test karta hoon... haan, ab checkout pe discount dikh raha hai.

items.description: Support will check the wrong company name on the invoice with the billing team and tell the customer.
evidence: main billing team se check karke aapko kal tak bata dunga.

items.description: Support explained that the customer can extend the expiry date themselves in the coupon settings, where the date option is.
evidence: Expiry aap khud coupon settings mein badha sakte ho, wahin date ka option milega.

items.description: Customer will extend the coupon's expiry date in the coupon settings.
evidence: Haan, main aaj raat badha dunga.

skip_recommendation.explanation: Complete Hinglish support call with clear outcomes.
